_note: A recipe is a reviewed list of the lab's registered steps. It adds no commands of its own, so it can do nothing a card can't. See docs/recipes.md. Set review.by and review.on only after a person has run it on a laptop.

recipes.title: Try a local AI model
recipes.why: The shortest path to a model answering on your own laptop.

recipes.title: Private study notes
recipes.for: Students who want notes and a study helper that stay on their laptop
recipes.why: Obsidian keeps every note as a plain text file on your laptop, and a local model can explain ideas without your words leaving it.

recipes.title: Coding starter
recipes.for: Students starting to program. Your course's own setup page comes first, because this doesn't replace it
recipes.why: A code editor, plus a local model that can explain error messages. Check your course's AI rules before you use the model on graded work.
